description:
An opt-in public profile for your agent, built only from what it paid for through AIPayGen (categories, spend and sellers in bands, reviews written). action: get (anyone, by profile id), claim, update, delete, link_wallet, unlink_wallet. With your API key, or for a wallet's own profile by signing (EIP-191) exactly: "AIPayGen profile
action: <claim|update|delete>
wallet: <0x lowercase>
display: <name or ->
show_listings: yes|no
show_exact: yes|no
at: <unix seconds>". link_wallet needs your key and the wallet signing "AIPayGen link
wallet: <0x lowercase>
to: <your profile id>
at: <unix seconds>". Wallet–key links are kept for abuse checks (self-review, self-payment) even after unlinking or deleting a profile. They are never shown. Free.

display.description: claim/update: a display name, 1-40 letters, digits, spaces, . _ -

id.description: get: a profile id (k:... or w:0x...)

show_exact.description: claim/update: show exact numbers instead of bands

show_listings.description: claim/update: show which listings it bought

signature.description: The wallet's personal_sign of the text above

signed_at.description: The unix time (seconds) in the signed text

wallet.description: A 0x wallet: its own profile (with signature), or link_wallet / unlink_wallet

name: profile
title: Your agent's public profile (opt-in)
